reviews.author: MetalerMetaller
reviews.text:
*Steamed pork restaurant in Seongsu

A restaurant with a signature dish, the killer ‘gup-sal’ near the ribs.

In the case of kipsal, it is so popular that it is difficult to eat even though there is a limit of 2 people per table, and only a limited amount is sold. In case it is sold out, we recommend the next main dish, pork neck. In the case of pork belly, it may not be specially selected at this restaurant, but it has an ordinary taste and is not recommended.

The staff grills the meat themselves, making it a very comfortable meal. The meat is also very fresh, so even though it is expensive, it is still satisfying.  The combination of perilla leaves and radish that comes with ssam (ssam) wrapped in ssam is also amazing and adds to the taste of the meat. It can be refilled, and the vinegared ginger, jalapeño, ssamjang, and wasabi that come with it also help eliminate the greasiness, making for a fantastic combination.

In the case of the rice, it was quite long and had a slightly salty taste, which was nice because it gave it a different taste. However, I think 3,000 won for a bowl of rice is definitely expensive.

Truffle Chapagetti has very chewy noodles and is sprinkled with soft-boiled eggs and truffle powder, giving it a fantastic taste. To be honest, the meat was very delicious, but personally, I liked the truffle Chapagetti the best at this restaurant. The price is 5,000 won, but is it correct to boil one bag? It was surprisingly small, but it felt small because it was delicious, and I think it was even more so because the bowl was large. As of June 2023, the price has been raised to 6,000 won, and the taste is still good, but the premium price of 6,000 won with truffle powder and eggs is still expensive, but it is the signature of this place, so I recommend eating it when you visit.

The red pepper paste pasta also had chewy noodles, which made it a bit difficult to eat, but the red pepper paste sauce wasn't that spicy and the addition of the soft-boiled egg gave it a great flavor. When I visited again in June 2023, the menu had disappeared, so I inquired and was told that the menu was removed and raw raw fish menu was added due to a lot of likes and dislikes.

I visited on the weekend, and the restaurant opened at 12 o'clock, so I went there 15 minutes before and there were already 2 teams waiting, and by 12 o'clock, there were almost 10 teams waiting, so it is a very popular place, so I recommend going in advance before it opens.

*In June 2023, even though I visited again after a year, I was impressed by the kindness of the staff and the staff who still cooked the food quickly and deliciously. Even though it is a fairly small store, I think this is possible because there are quite a lot of employees. Many restaurants use fewer staff to save on labor costs and people are disappointed by the poor quality of service, but I think the owner made a good decision by raising the menu prices to secure labor costs. Even though I visited at 4pm on a weekend, it was almost full, so it seems like the table turnover rate was still good.

reviews.text: Yesterday at work, the team leader said he was having lunch ＼(^^)／ Thanks to that, I ended up going to the relatively recently(?) opened Shabuin Seoul Seongsu branch! As soon as I first walked in, my first thought was that the atmosphere was nice. The staff showed me to the room, and as expected, the room had a nice atmosphere. I ordered through the table kiosk, and after a few minutes, the staff gave me a brief explanation and I started eating shabu-shabu right away. The vegetables, mushrooms, and meat were fresh and delicious. I tasted both the clear mushroom and the soybean paste flavor (the ingredients for the soybean paste were slightly different), and I think the clear mushroom expressed the taste of shabu-shabu better. When you finish eating shabu-shabu, the staff comes back and makes porridge or risotto for you. After finishing my meal, I felt good drinking Schisandra chinensis tea (I think it would taste like this if it had the flavor of Schisandra chinensis). I'm not sure about the price since I didn't buy it, but I know it's a bit expensive for a company lunch. I think it would be a good place to go when you go out with friends or acquaintances.

reviews.author: unique
reviews.text: I went to Mentsuru Seongsu branch. Although the store is small, I was impressed by the unique atmosphere of a Japanese ramen restaurant. The menu was relatively simple, so it wasn't difficult to choose, and the food was presented well, so I had high expectations. The ramen broth was rich but not overpowering, so I was able to enjoy it until the end, and the noodles were chewy and had a good texture. Even if I visited alone, I was able to eat comfortably in an atmosphere that didn't feel awkward, and I felt like it was a place I wanted to stop by again when I was craving ramen in Seongsu.

reviews.author: Seonae Lee
reviews.text: I was hungry when I was about to enter Seongsu from Suseo Station, and I finally found Mentsuru Seongsu. Starting with my favorite Soyu Ramen, the chicken skin menu was an appropriate and light lunch to enjoy. A place where you can enjoy leisurely even by yourself.

reviews.author: belly fat fairy

reviews.author: Min
reviews.text:
Although the wait is a bit long, it is a yakitori restaurant with good taste and reasonable price.

I visited at 8pm on a Friday evening and there was only one other group waiting in front, so I thought we would get in quickly, but the turnover rate was low so I ended up waiting for just an hour. What's worse is that they don't even wait for our Daum Daum team. There's a high probability that you won't be able to come in.

The variety of skewer menus reminds me of a Japanese yakitori restaurant, but there is some variation in the level of grilling for each skewer. The egg skewers were unexpectedly delicious, and the pork belly and lamb shoulder were overcooked and a bit tough. But overall it was okay. The skewers have a sweet and salty taste, so if you are going to order a lot of skewers, it would be okay to grill them with salt in the latter part of the meal. As I continued to eat, I felt a bit bitten. The service is friendly :)

A review that has been around for a while

Ordered Jjamppong rice and Jjajangmyeon.
To conclude, the jjamppong rice was delicious, but the jjajangmyeon was really bad.

Jjamppong rice is not served separately, but rice is rolled into the soup.
I prefer it separately, but next time I go and eat jjamppong rice, I'll have to ask if it's possible to order it separately.
Usually, some glass noodles are added to jjamppong rice, but this one included some regular wheat flour noodles, so I was able to taste a little of the jjamppong noodles.
I think most Jjamppong or Jjamppong rice are good enough to be enjoyed without any problems.
However, the jjajangmyeon doesn't have the sweet and salty taste that is the basis of jjajang. It seems like they were trying to make it taste bad, but it only tastes a bit like a burnt taste, but even that is tasteless. This is the first time in my life that I have eaten a regular size of jjajang and tried to leave it behind.

When I searched, I found some saying that the taste differs depending on the Hong Kong restaurant branch, and some saying that most Hong Kong restaurants have delicious jjamppong and mediocre jjajang.

Anyway, I don't know if it was just the day we went, but I promised myself that even if I went back to eat Jjamppong, I would never, ever eat Jjajang.

Good Jjambbong restaurant + reasonable price.
Jjamppong satisfaction (4 stars)

Sook, a trusted dining space in Seongsu. This is already my third visit, and I am very satisfied every time I go.

This time, I was especially impressed with the wine pairing. Thanks to the wine recommended by the sommelier to match the food, I started lightly and soon found myself opening several bottles. If you like wine, be sure to get this recommendation. The balance between food and wine is really great.

The fact that Chef Lee Jong-wook, a former Michelin-starred restaurant chef, cooks the food himself gives us confidence, and in fact, all of the menu items, including strip steak, lamb ribs, truffle foie gras, and black barley risotto, are of high quality.
Even my child, who is a picky eater and would never eat tough meat, really enjoyed the steak, and I could feel from his reaction how good the ingredients and cooking quality were.

The atmosphere is sophisticated and quiet, making it perfect for anniversaries or special gatherings.
I think Sook will continue to be on my family’s regular list in the future.

reviews.author: awk mee
reviews.text:
This is a great wood-fired pizza restaurant in Seongsu-dong that I went to for some healing this weekend!

Since I'm trying to lose weight, I'm always cautious about what to eat out, but the 'BTS Pizza' I ordered here was an excellent choice. Beef, tomatoes, and a mountain of fresh salad were piled on top of the chewy oven-baked dough aged for 48 hours, so I ate it very freshly and heartily without feeling guilty.

I was also very satisfied with the Italian street snacks I ordered on the side. ‘Tomato Cheese Panzerotti’, which tastes like crispy fried pizza, and ‘Ragu Arancini’, fried rice with rich ragù sauce, are the epitome of taste. At the end, I refreshed my mouth with Chilsung Cider Zero, making it a perfect meal.

It is a 3-minute walk from Exit 4 of Seongsu Station, so accessibility is excellent, and as a second brand of Agio with 30 years of history, the store interior exudes a local Italian sensibility. There is a wood-fired pizza menu for one person, so you don't have to worry about eating alone, and the atmosphere is so pretty that I highly recommend it as a place for dates or gatherings. The staff were friendly and I had a pleasant meal.

reviews.text: It's a place in Seongsu that's famous for good value for money and one-person wood-fired pizza. reviews.author: Kyurindate
reviews.text: I went to Seongsu Station Restaurant Casa Agio Seongsu Main Branch😍 It's a 3-minute walk from Exit 4 of Seongsu Station, and it's the second brand of Agio in Insa-dong, so it has an Italian home-like atmosphere! It's so popular that there's a wait even if you visit at 1pm, so it's a good idea to make a reservation before a date or blind date. As I sat at the window seat, the interior was full of Christmas sensibility, making it the perfect date destination for Seongsu. Carbonara Mafaldine is an original style flavored with only eggs, cheese, and pepper, so the sauce is thick and the seasoning penetrates well between the thick Mafaldine noodles, giving you a rich flavor in every bite. The seafood tomato pasta had plenty of seafood, including squid and shrimp, and the refreshing tomato sauce went well with the light spaghetti noodles, so it was great to enjoy regardless of whether you like it or not. The arancini I ordered as a side was crispy on the outside and filled with hot risotto and cheese on the inside. It was fun to see the cheese stretching out when I cut it in half with a knife. Ragu Arancini is soaked in plenty of meat sauce, so it has a rich texture and flavor, while Tomato Basil Arancini has the scent of basil and the freshness of tomatoes, making it fun to compare and eat. The focaccia-like bread provided at each table is perfect for dipping with leftover sauce, and with refreshing Bundaberg grapefruit and Zero Cola, it's the perfect combination for breakfast or a date! Seongsu-dong's one-person wood-fired pizza is baked right in the oven, so it's great for eating alone. It's a restaurant in Seongsu Station that even has gargles and dental floss for mouthwash so you can finish your meal refreshed😍

reviews.text:
The pasta is delicious too...
A place with chicken pilaf that is more famous than pasta

Although the neighborhood is popular, the store is located on the second floor of a renovated house. Of course, it's clean inside.

The pasta is above average. The point of this place is that the menu items other than pasta are unique and delicious.
In particular, I can see why chicken pilaf is so popular.

Beef Cream Pasta
(Difficult creamy pasta with blue cheese and beef)
I took a bite and um... it was delicious!

Eggplant gratin
(Gratin with eggplant filling, cream cheese & mozzarella cheese on homemade tomato sauce)
This is the first special menu. It was good enough to be featured! Even though I don't really like eggplant, I ate it without any hesitation.
The sauce was slightly salty, so it went well with the bread on the side.

rose pasta
(Rosé pasta with shrimp flavor and homemade sauce)
Of the six menus, this was the one that received the lowest score from everyone. Everything can't be delicious~

Spicy Ragu Pasta
(Spicy homemade tomato pasta with minced beef)
This is delicious. The proportion of tomato sauce is not high and it is a bit greasy.
I don't like tomato sauce, but I ended up scooping it up with a spoon.
It tastes like a delicious and not too salty seasoning for stir-fried pork. It reminded me of rice~

Chicken Pilaf
(Spicy pilaf made with stir-fried spicy chicken thighs and vegetables)
Actually, I guess I came here because of this menu. Once you take a bite, you will feel the same way!
uh! What is this?
Although the seasoning is strong, it is not too salty and is delicious so you can keep eating it.
The carrot powder seems to have a strong taste, but it is not strong. I was curious, so I asked and was told that Parmesan and almond powder were the ingredients.

I think more people visit this place for the chicken pilaf and eggplant gratin.

reviews.author: Meng2
reviews.text: I had a trip to Seongsu, and I heard it was a famous wood-fired pizza restaurant, so I signed up for the waiting list early in the morning. There are a total of 8 tables in the store. It opens at 11:30 and waiting registration is possible from 10:50, but I registered at 10:30 and registered number 8, so I was able to eat right away at the first time. I ordered the signature Garibaldi and Margherita Classica, and although I didn't order any other drinks, there was also an Aperol Spritz and Limoncello. I expected the cheese-based Garibaldi to be greasy, but the pepper neutralized it and went well with it. The Margherita had fresh cheese and basil, and the tomato sauce, which was more acidic than sweet, went well with the ingredients. If you ask for it, they give you olive oil and slightly spicy olive oil. When I dipped it in, the overall flavor of the pizza came out and I enjoyed it even more. It was a store worth visiting at least once😋

reviews.author: KEKKEK
reviews.text:
I went to Italy last year and I keep thinking about wood-fired pizza. So I visited. There were 4 teams in front of me and I think we waited for 30 minutes.
The weather was quite cold, but the waiting area outside was very cold. There is no stove and no windbreak installed.
So I can't give you much service score. I ordered and ate the most basic Margherita. The dough itself is very chewy and salty, and it smells too burnt.
Tomatoes have a very strong acidity.
It has just three flavors and aromas and no umami at all.
The Margherita I ate in Italy was very simple but delicious because the dough and tomato sauce had a rich flavor.
It doesn't taste good to me. Since it is a wood-fired pizza, of course there must be burnt parts. But overall, the burnt smell is in the food. The burnt parts were so badly burned that they were bitter and inedible. I wonder if the burnt smell is in the oven itself or how the pizza itself got the burnt smell, but I was very disappointed because it didn't taste as good as I expected.
Espresso is also average. The crema is good, but a bit bland with a bit of acidity.
